name: Opulent Knightshade
summary: The Opulent Knightshade is one of the mysterious so-called "Opulent" of the Night Market who control the Gilded, Argent and Brazen below them and is associated with Sorrow's Friend as its ruler. She can be found with the Web Eater and Arid Varlet in the Opulent Ordeal trial. She takes the form of a humanoid Gloam Knight. It is rumored that she created the Baleful Darkness of Sorrow's Friend to better control her district and torment people. According to one survivor's testimony, once the darkness had stripped all but his sense of hearing, he began to hear whispers telling him terrible things, until he tore his own ears off.
